mandate.target: every log file has shipped its new bytes and every pending transcript request is answered (found-or-explicitly-not-found), every tick
checklist: if FLEET_MESSENGER_DRIVER unset: log once that logs stay local-only, exit 0 -- this is a valid mode, not an error
call the driver's ship_logs against FLEET_LOG_DIR
call the driver's relay_transcript for any pending request the driver's own state reports
never let a driver failure change this script's own exit code -- best-effort, side channel only
a backlog beyond the driver's own cap ships bounded, never unbounded replay
skim the log's recent tail (not just this tick) for a repeating error a single run can't see
mandate.escalation: the driver reports a config error (exit 2) rather than a transient failure -- log it loudly once per distinct error, do not retry-spam every tick on a misconfiguration nothing will fix by waiting.
